authorshipSource.finding: The selected series identifies BeitHaBechira as Menachem benShlomo of theMeir family. The Ketubot/BavaBatra/Avot introductions explicitly name the author. No contrary authorship attribution was found in the inspected selected pages; this is not a survey of disputes beyond those source pages.
